name: lisachenko/z-engine
description: Write PHP extensions in pure PHP: direct FFI access to the Zend Engine internals

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the test suite (segfault-prone internal group excluded)
scripts-descriptions.test:internal: Run the segfault-prone internal test group with process isolation (use a debug PHP build)
scripts-descriptions.test:opcache: Run the opcache/shared-memory tests and FAIL if any of them skipped (they are self-skipping when opcache is unavailable)
scripts-descriptions.test:opcache-zts: Same non-skip gate on ZTS builds - kept as the named alias CI's ZTS legs call; since issue #118 the file-cache relocator tests run there too
scripts-descriptions.test:opcache-runner: Run the suite for an opcache-ACTIVE runner (opcache.enable_cli=1): excludes the usual performance/internal groups plus opcache-incompatible, the issue-linked tests that cannot hold when the runner's own files live in shared memory
scripts-descriptions.test:performance: Run the excluded performance group (the 'zero FFI at call time' benchmark) and FAIL if it silently skipped - its verdict is timing-based, so the CI leg that runs it is informational
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run static analysis at the maximum level
scripts-descriptions.gen-headers: Regenerate FFI engine definitions from the PHP source (docker on Linux, native toolchain elsewhere)
